cluster_summary: A set of vulnerabilities in inventory/GUI storage code that lead to item duplication due to inadequate synchronization between GUI and backing storage, missing player context in storage updates, and lack of validation of slot properties (fake slots, modification permissions). One outlier involves a missing permission check in a packet handler for file modification.
guideline_text: Trace attacker-influenced inputs, resource identities, state values, or configuration described by the member CVEs into the sensitive operation or security boundary described by the member CVEs. Report code paths where the required validation, authorization, isolation, state check, or binding is absent or not connected to the sensitive effect. Confirm that the guard is enforced before the sensitive effect and remains bound to the same resource, principal, destination, or object that the effect uses. Treat this as a reusable mechanism-level pattern derived from 1 historical CVE example(s), not as a project-specific signature. A safe implementation should Add explicit checks for slot.isFake() and slot.allowModification()/canPlace() before proceeding with any read/write operations; reject transfers on violation..

mechanism.name: Missing slot property validation before item transfer
mechanism.sink_shape: the sensitive operation or security boundary described by the member CVEs
mechanism.source_shape: attacker-influenced inputs, resource identities, state values, or configuration described by the member CVEs
mechanism.typical_fix: Add explicit checks for slot.isFake() and slot.allowModification()/canPlace() before proceeding with any read/write operations; reject transfers on violation.

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Add explicit checks for slot.isFake() and slot.allowModification()/canPlace() before proceeding with any read/write operations; reject transfers on violation.
sub_patterns.name: Missing slot property validation before item transfer
sub_patterns.root_cause: Item transfer logic assumed all slots are valid and writable without checking whether the slot is fake (display-only) or whether modification is allowed, allowing operations on restricted slots that can lead to duplication.
